RAHUL KUMAR B

Hyderabad, India

+919529647859

rahulbajoria369@gmail.com

SUMMARY

Having a total of 10.5+ years of experience including 7+ years in Capital Markets domain and 5.2 years as a Functional Business Analyst. Experienced in Derivatives, OTC products, Money Market, Bonds/Fixed Income, and Corporate Actions with Global Banking Projects (CITI, UBS, HSBC, FAB UAE). Skilled in requirement gathering, BRD/FRD preparation, Agile methodologies, stakeholder management, trade lifecycle processes and UAT support, and collaboration with PMO team for project governance, status tracking, RAID management, and delivery reporting. Strong experience working with cross-functional teams in banking and financial services environments. Certified in Investment Banking and Project Management (PMP), Scrum Master (PSM I), Agile Coaching, and Product Ownership, with an MCA and currently pursuing an MBA in General Management.

EXPERIENCE

ACCENTURE

Mumbai, India

Senior Business Analyst  Capital Markets	5/2023 to 04/2026

Worked as a Business Analyst for Capital Markets applications supporting financial products such as OTC Derivatives, Bonds, Mutual Funds, FX, Money Market instruments, and Corporate Actions.

Collaborated with Broadridge Financial Solutions and end client UBS for trade processing and application enhancement activities.

Involved in trade capture, trade validation, and transaction processing activities through trading applications and backend systems in zoom trading platform.

Performed trade modification, amendments, cancellations, and transaction updates as part of trade lifecycle management.

Analyzed business requirements and translated them into functional specifications, BRD, FRD, and user stories.

Conducted requirement gathering sessions with business users, stakeholders, and support teams to understand functional and operational needs.

Coordinated with development, QA, and production support teams for issue analysis, defect resolution, and release activities.

Participated in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test case validation, defect tracking, and business sign off activities.

Used SQL queries for data validation, trade verification, reconciliation support, and reporting analysis.

Monitored trade processing workflows and validated trade IDs, transaction status

Assisted PMO team in project governance activities including status tracking, RAID management, milestone tracking, and project reporting.

Prepared project status reports, dashboards, and progress updates for stakeholders and management review.

Coordinated release management and sprint delivery activities to ensure timely project execution in Agile environment.

Worked closely with cross-functional global teams and stakeholders to support delivery, process improvement, and operational efficiency initiatives.

LTI MINDTREE

Pune, India

Business Analyst	02/2021 to 05/2023

Worked as a Business Analyst for Capital Markets and Treasury applications on the Murex MX.3.1 platform.

Collaborated with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Operations, and business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.

Analyzed end-to-end trade lifecycle processes for FX Forwards, Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Options, Equities, Loans, Deposits, Commercial Papers (CP), Certificates of Deposit (CD), and OTC Derivatives.

Conducted requirement analysis, gap analysis, and impact assessment for new business requests, regulatory changes, and production enhancements.



Prepared and reviewed functional requirements, process flows, business scenarios, and acceptance criteria for development teams.

Worked closely with developers, QA, and business users to clarify requirements, resolve functional queries, and ensure solution alignment with business objectives.

Performed functional validation of Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office processes including trade booking, confirmation, settlement, accounting, reporting, cancellations, and reissue events.

Worked on Murex modules including E-Tradepad, One Stop Processing (OSP), Trade Query, and GLCMS to support trade processing and operational workflows.

Participated in backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement walkthroughs, and Agile ceremonies to support iterative delivery.

Conducted impact analysis, supported SIT and UAT, coordinated defect triage, and validated business fixes before production deployment.

Validated SWIFT message generation and monitored ACK/NACK responses through SWIFT Alliance to ensure accurate settlement messaging.

Supported counterparty onboarding, RDG configuration, and reference data validation based on business requirements.

Assisted release management by coordinating business sign-offs, production verification.

TRISTHA GLOBAL PVT LTD

Mumbai, India

Test Engineer	11/2019 to 06/2020

Worked as part of the UAT team for a banking treasury application (Intellect Money Market Front Office), supporting client validation activities

Performed UAT testing for financial products including Loans, Deposits, and Bonds across regions (NAM, EMEA, APAC)

Executed and validated various deal types such as RFR, Bullet, and Floating rate transactions

Captured and processed trades using key parameters like counterparty, currency, amount, value date, and maturity date

Validated interest calculations and schedules using Microsoft Excel and backend data from Oracle Database

Verified trade booking and lifecycle through User Console, Deal Query, and Blotter systems

Analyzed ACK and XML messages to ensure correct system processing and integration

Collaborated with business and technical teams to identify and resolve defects and data inconsistencies

TEMENOS INDIA PVT LTD

Bangalore,India

Test Engineer	12/2018 to 07/2019

Worked on Multifonds Global Fund Accounting (MFGA) product, supporting regression and functional testing activities and Created and validated fund setups and financial transactions as per client requirements

Performed NAV simulation and accounting validation for various financial asset classes

Prepared and executed test cases based on Business Requirement Documents (BRD)

Conducted manual and regression testing for projects involving HSBC and RBC

Extracted and validated data using Oracle Database (SQL queries)

Logged and tracked defects using HP ALM, ensuring timely resolution

Collaborated with developers and business teams to resolve defects and improve system quality

NIIT TECHNILOGIES

Bangalore,India

Senior Executive	04/2018 to 11/2018

Worked on USA based Global Investment Banking Project

Updating daily missing rates of Mutal Fund using rate fixer application

Placing Buy and Sell trade for any difference between Trust and Fund

Transferring funds from one account to another Through DTCC

Changing investment request whether client wants Cash/Cash or Reinvestment/ Reinvestment

Research and paying dividend monthly basis, on the basis of NAV calculation

Cash Reconciliation between trust and TLM application

Resolving tickets generated by clients due to out of balance, through research, for this we using MFD, Fund application, trust application etc.



DM TRADERS & CO.

Raniganj, W.B, India

Accountant	04/2014 to 09/2017

Maintenance of books of accounts in Tally ERP 9

Maintenance of register and payroll

Maintenance of bank accounts

Preparation for VAT return

Support the audit team and presentation of documents and information before presenting auditors

Reconciliation of account receivable and account payable with books

Communicating with suppliers and customers for payment and collection

SKILLS

DOMAIN

Capital / Money Market/Trade Lifecycle

BFSI/Investment Bank/Treasury Operations

Derivative/Bond/FX/Corporate Action

SWIFT Messaging/Trade Validation

Mutual Fund

REPORTING & DOCUMENTATION

Microsoft Excel/Word

BRD/FRD Documentation

User Stories & Functional Specifications

AGILE / DELIVERY

Scrum Ceremonies/Sprint Planning

Backlog Tracking/User Story Management

Sprint Metrics/Velocity Monitoring / Burndown Tracking

Agile Delivery & PMO Coordination with Status Reporting

TECHNICAL TOOLS

Temenos Multifond

Intellect Money Market

Murex MX 3.1

Trading ZOOM Application.

Jira /Azure DevOps

DB/Confluence

Postman/XML

CORE SKILLS/COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis & Functional Requirement Gathering

Capital Markets Domain Knowledge

Stakeholder Management & Communication

BRD / FRD / User Story Preparation

Trade Lifecycle & Transaction Processing

UAT Coordination & Functional Validation

Cross-functional Team Coordination

Risk, Issue & Dependency Tracking

CERTIFICATIONS

Project Management Professional ((PMP)®), Project Management Institute, PMI USA.

ICP-ACC® (Agile Coach) from IC_ Agile International.

Professional Scrum Master (PSM I), Scrum.org.

Certified SAFe® POPM, Product Owner/Product Manager (Expired Jan 2026)

ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level & Agile Tester (CTFL-AT).

Six Sigma Green & Black Belt Certified, Star Agile.

Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional, Imarticus Learning, CIBOP.

Basics Financial Market Certification, Elearnmarkets.

EDUCATION
